userStories.title: GOBLIN batch runner — tranche-gated brainstorm at scale
acceptanceCriteria: Script runs N epochs (default tranche_size=30)

HAL escalation: ESCALATE flag if p_grip < 0.4 or p_harm > 0.7
reducer_decision field absent from all epoch outputs (enforced in schema)
JSONL output one line per epoch to brainstorm/batches/
Tranche receipt written at boundary: schema=GOBLIN_BATCH_TRANCHE_V1, reducer_decision=null
Script stops at tranche boundary and prints MAYOR review instructions
dry-run flag: skips API, writes deterministic seed entries for schema validation
All outputs: authority=NON_SOVEREIGN, canon=NO_SHIP
